hook.name: GlassBoxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook with authorized pool creation and a mandatory dynamic LP fee. beforeSwap enforces a per-pool trading-start timestamp and applies a linearly-decaying anti-snipe LP fee override. afterSwap collects a configurable protocol fee (in bps) from swap output, routes it to a configurable fee sink, and awards Prism points per swap.
